body.statement: When \(r=1\) and \(b_n/a_n\to0\), the center and first-order half-width of \(I_n^{\mathrm{out}}\) reduce to the rank-one four-block spectral plug-in center and Gaussian variance formula of Yan--Wainwright, up to \(o_P(a_n)\).
body.justification: The reduction is the required sanity check in the standard regular special case.
body.gap: This is a compatibility result rather than a novelty claim; it prevents the transition construction from changing the established regular target.
body.consumer: Existing rank-one implementations can adopt the transition correction without changing their regular-regime estimand.
